Method of Attack: Malicious post-install script executed during npm install that scans for secrets like GitHub/NPM tokens and environment variables
Uses discovered developer credentials to publish new malicious updates to other packages maintained by the same user, enabling self-propagation
Injects malicious GitHub Actions workflows to exfiltrate secrets, make private repos public, or migrate them
Creates public GitHub repositories named 'Shai-Hulud' to dump stolen credentials
Impacted Systems: CI/CD pipelines relying on compromised packages
GitHub repositories linked to compromised tokens
Attack Vector: Compromised npm packages with malicious post-install scripts
Exploitation of leaked GitHub and npm tokens
Injection of malicious GitHub Actions workflows
Public GitHub repos named 'Shai-Hulud' and repos with '-migration' suffix made public
Indicators of Compromise: Unexpected versions of dependencies in package.json or package-lock.json
Presence of unknown post-install or lifecycle scripts in package.json
Unfamiliar GitHub Actions workflows in repositories
Environment variables or developer machines showing tokens like GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, and cloud keys
Malicious bundle.js files executed during npm install
